name: Brave Origin
description:
Brave Origin is a stripped-down, debloated variant of the Brave web browser. It removes cryptocurrency wallets, sponsored rewards, VPN promotions, and other non-essential additions while preserving Brave's core privacy shields and performance.

Features:
- Streamlined browsing experience free of cryptocurrency and Web3 features
- Built-in ad-blocking and privacy tracking protection enabled by default
- Fast Chromium-based rendering engine with low memory footprint
- Complete support for Chrome Web Store extensions and themes
- Private browsing mode with built-in fingerprinting protections
